steps: Convinced she's about to get fired, Laru's counting on you to help save her job...!
Oh no, oh no, oh no.
The buyer told me she'd taken the order sheet, but it's still sitting here...
How could she mistake the random stuff you scribbled for an official work document?
Because I scribbled it on a blank purchase-order form...
This way, even if I'm slacking off, nobody will notice. It's a perfect disguise.
Too perfect though.==W== Even the buyer is fooled.
What should I do now?==W== The purchase is probably already made at this point.
I got, it, Boss!==W== You can go rob all of them for me!
Even if it means committing robbery, we can't let this batch of fries be delivered.
Calm down. You just ordered the wrong stuff for the afternoon tea. Maybe it's no big deal.
If it were actually for us, I guess not.
But it's for the Senate! They'll definitely come after me for this.
In a place like the Grace Imperium...==W== The moment you show any weakness, people will pounce on you and tear you apart.
You don't seem to enjoy working much anyway. If you do get fired, you can just take the opportunity to fish in peace.
Think of it as taking a break.
Absolutely not! How can I fish like that?!
Sneaking off to fish while your boss thinks you're hard at work ...==W== is completely different from being unemployed and having nothing to do but kill time with fishing!
That jittery thrill of almost getting caught, the pride of secretly rebelling, and the guilty pleasure of getting paid to do nothing—==W==that's the true art of slacking off!
If you don't even have a job, it's not called slacking off, just … being a jobless bum! You get it?
Sure sure, I absolutely get it.
Sob... This is horrible!==W== How could you carefree Trekkers possibly understand how we office people feel!
Don't people say "working is for suckers" these days?
But if I manage to slack off during work, then I'm not a sucker, but a winner!
And if I can eat fries while fishing during work, that makes me a winner twice over!
You should just get yourself fired. I'm starting to pity Grace Imperium for hiring someone like you.
Do you think it's possible that...
By this time tomorrow, the Goddess of Fries will make the Senate all fall in love with fries?
No matter how much you love fries, there's no way you can eat it every day for a month straight.
Darn it... How did it come to this...
That's just an office legend. I don't wanna be the first one to try it.
If that fails, I won't be able to get hired anywhere in Emor, then I'll have to head out into the wilds and become a Trekker.
What are you looking at me like that for? New Star Guild doesn't take on new members.
No, no, Boss. I don't mean New Star Guild. Don't you have your own company?
If I get fired, you can just hire me! Problem solved!
Hey, ==W==Boss! ==W==I heard your company's a little short-handed. ==W==Soooo... ♪ ==W==I bet you could use a beautiful, ==W==intelligent, ==W==talented, ==W==and totally dependable secretary?
Are you sure?==W== An opportunity like this doesn't come around twice! ==W====W==It's true I slack off sometimes, ==W==but I promise you won't regret it.==W==
I imagine a talent such as yourself doesn't come cheap
Oh, money-schmoney! ==W==I'll give you the Friends and Family discount!==W== And I KNOW ==W==you won't let a helpless young lady like me get laid off with nowhere to go, would you?==W==
With an elderly cat ==W==and a two-year old puppy at home ... ==W==and 30 years left on her mortgage ... ==W==(sniff)==W==
I seem to recall once you telling me how good you are at pulling heartstrings...
Oh... ==W==THAT silly old talk! ==W==Never mind that—==W==I've seriously never been in a bind like this before.==W==You're the only hope I have in the whole wide world!
Why didn't you just ask for help up front?
You think ==W==I can come right out and beg?==W==
I mean, like... ==W==You're the only person I've ever ... ==W==spoken to so honestly, ==W==you know?
Oh yeah? The only one, huh?
Why are you laughing!? ==W====W==I'm seriously in trouble here! Grr!
Think about it, Boss! ==W==What if you couldn't see me whenever you wanted anymore! ==W==I know ==W==you'd be sad! ==W==Please, Boss! ==W==I really need you right now! Hire me!
If I happen to get fired, you'll definitely get me a new job!
You'll let me join your company so I can slack off—==W==uh, no, I mean, work hard there.
If it comes to that, let me know.
I'll find a way to give you an impossible workload so you won't have any time to slack off.
Judging by the look on your face, I take it you didn't get into trouble for the afternoon tea fiasco?
I was just about to talk to you about this. Come here, I'll whisper.
I think the Goddess of Fries really was at work.
After you left yesterday, I packed up my things and was just waiting for Angel to fire me.
And guess what? The Senate, for some reason, wants to study a fast-food industry that mimics Monolith food.
My fries were a great hit! They even asked me to get more Monolith food.
Even Angel was surprised and asked me how did I figure it out in advance.
Anyway, the crisis is over, so let's go fishing today to celebrate!
It's not like you have to work. Let's go!
Guess Laru blew her luck getting out of the afternoon tea mess—==W==because all we caught that day were a bunch of lousy water weeds.
